SeizureGuard: no watch data for 8 hours

watch and phone app versions differ
Note: the watch and phone apps were on different versions. Update both.

SeizureGuard sends your watch data to OpenSeizureDetector (OSD). Problems are shown quietly here, without sound or vibration. One exception: if no watch data arrives for 8 hours, the phone vibrates once (no sound).
Before starting: 1. In OSD, set the data source to Garmin and make sure OSD is running with its web server on. 2. In OSD settings, turn OFF "Enable Audible System FaultWarnings". Otherwise OSD itself will beep on faults. 3. Keep this phone charging overnight. If its battery runs low, OSD goes into a fault and an alarm cannot fire.
Then tap Start bridge. You only need this screen to start or stop it.
Allow Nearby devices, or the bridge cannot start.
